verdict.rationale: Cal.com's docs explicitly list routing forms as a core feature (docs-28) and expose a dedicated API for tracing 'how the booking was routed through routing forms, CRM lookups, and host selection logic' (cal-com-docs-8), confirming invitee answers drive routing decisions. Team scheduling configs also support round-robin host selection with priority/weight/lead-threshold/CRM fallback (cal-com-docs-15/25/41), reinforcing routing-to-right-person capability. Missing for 10: no detailed documentation of the routing form builder UI itself (question types, conditional branching rules) or independent/hands-on confirmation of routing form setup and accuracy.
